subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

C _ B N _ _ V_ _ H C _ B _ H
solution:
Given :- C _ B N _ _ V_ _ H C _ B _ H

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) VHCBNVN → C **V** B N **H - C** V **B N** H - C **V** B **N** H

 
• Here **"CVBNH" **is repeated.

2) HVCNBVN → C **H** B N **V - C **V **N B** H - C **V** B** N** H

3) VCBHNVN → C **V** B N **C - B** V **H N** H - C **V** B **N** H

4) VHBNCHV → C **V** B N **H - B** V **N C** H - C **H** B **V** H

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- C V B N H - C V B N H - C V B N H

Hence, the correct answer is **"VHCBNVN".**
